name: KAWAII LAB. Transit Timetable DB v2
purpose: Train-centric scheduled-timetable database for route search with explicit same-train continuity and destination preservation.

TrainTimetableFragment.notes: One source timetable fragment. A physical train may have multiple fragments across railway/operator boundaries.

SameTrainEdge.notes: Directed continuation edge. Routing may preserve transfer count only across these edges.

NetworkJourney.notes: An exact source that already describes one physical train across multiple railway IDs. Published third-party journeys use source-exact-network and retain sourceProvider/sourceURL/sourceSha256. Their calendar is a foreign key to the registered source calendar catalog; it is not an unconditional weekday label.

PublishedCalendarRule.notes: A date-restricted raw source expression must not be expanded to every listed weekday. An unspecified year remains null until separately verified.

PublishedStation.notes: Stable source physical-station key with railway-scoped existing DB aliases. Same-named stations on unrelated lines are not aliases.

transferRule: Increment transfer count only when the next boarded train is not connected to the current train by an explicit same-train edge or exact network journey continuation.

storage.networkJourneyFiles: Additional named JSON or gzip JSON journey files; readers must load all registered files and reject duplicate IDs
storage.sourceCatalogs: Per-source station aliases and calendar rule catalogs; source-scoped station/calendar keys resolve here
